WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM telescopes
),
shares AS (
  SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.n, sc.n * 1.0 / t.total AS share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.n) AS total_telescopes,
  AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_above_average
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
